scope: Original continuous NDU economic model, separated operators, recursive utility, temporal selves and games are retained. Precision success is not inferred from software success.

original_continuum.status_at_registration: Two deterministic post-review audits have already run; they are not preregistered confirmatory experiments
original_continuum.deployment: Feasible bilinear nodal feedback frozen between decision dates, original continuous Brownian process and first exit

learned_geometry.architecture: Four-parameter bounded actor: constant sigmoid consumption and portfolio, affine-tanh preference adjustment
learned_geometry.training: 256 random states per step; maximize original Hamiltonian of known witness g, without optimal-action labels
learned_geometry.model: Original NDU dynamics, control domain, covariance and first-exit settlement; running utility shifted by sup_a R_a(g)
learned_geometry.certificate: All-state continuous regret using outward interval action-gap bounds; original payoff is not claimed

external.adapter: Bounded actor, terminal-exact critic, nonconvex running cost, fixed CPU wall-clock budget
external.network: Two tanh hidden layers of width 48 for both methods
external.model: dX=2a dt+sqrt(2)*0.4 dW, a in [-1,1]^d; running cost mean(a^2)+0.3*sin(sum(a))+0.1*mean(sin(a)^2); terminal mean((X-0.5)^2)+0.2*cos(sum(X)/sqrt(d))
external.audit: 4096 paired paths; nested 64/128 time meshes; independent seed 12000+training seed
external.estimand: NBO minus SOC-MartNet realized cost at 128 steps; six-seed paired t interval; report path and mesh uncertainties separately
external.limitations: No optimality certificate and no reproduction of published hardware budgets. Constant diffusion matches the pinned author's supported interface.

preservation: No inherited manuscript, derivation, report, failure, source, array or checkpoint is deleted. R8 canonical manuscripts and response are complete plaintext, never incomplete transport capsules.
